answer.reason: The verses give him two events beyond his kingship: the battle in the vale of Siddim and his request to Abram for the rescued people.

clauses.english: went out to battle against Chedorlaomer and his allies in the vale of Siddim
clauses.quote: they joined battle with them in the vale of Siddim

clauses.english: asked Abram to give him the persons and keep the goods
clauses.quote: Give me the persons, and take the goods to thyself.

doubts: Verses after GEN 14:2 say only 'the king of Sodom' and do not repeat the name Bera; they are assumed to mean him.
GEN 14:10 says the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled and fell, but it is not marked and is unclear, so it is not used.
